title: Collection Surcharge on Lease Term Agreement Lease Breaks — Accounting Standard
content:
The reletting fee of a lease break on a Lease Term Agreement carries a collection surcharge set by the lease ledger: a lease carrying a past-due balance with a late fee dated fewer than 3 full calendar months before the handling date adds 150.00 dollars; a lease carrying a past-due balance with no such late fee adds 75.00 dollars; a lease with no past-due balance adds nothing.

**Assembly.** The part of the reletting fee obtained by applying the reletting rate to the contracted rent is rounded half up to the cent, and the collection surcharge is then added to it.

**Records read.** The balance the resident owes on the Apartment Home Lease ledger, and the late fees posted on that ledger by their posting date.

| Past-due balance on the Apartment Home Lease | Late fee dated fewer than 3 full months before the handling date | Collection surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 150.00 dollars |
| yes | no | 75.00 dollars |
| no | yes | nothing |
| no | no | nothing |

**Span edge (hypothetical).** Handling date 20 May: a late fee dated 21 February is inside the 3-month span; one dated 20 February is outside it.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A rate part of 1,713.18 dollars on a lease owing a past-due balance with a late fee posted last month: 1,713.18 plus 150.00 is 1,863.18 dollars.
